name: South Korean Party Statements
description: Official statements from party spokespersons and minutes from daily leadership meetings of South Korea's two major parties (Conservative and Progressive), covering 2003-09-28 to 2026-08-27. 121,271 total entries (51,141 conservative + 70,130 progressive): the 83,201 published v2022 rows, preserved unchanged, extended with 38,070 statements collected from the parties' official boards. 'filtered' carries the legacy khaiii parse for v2022 rows only.

columns.name: no
columns.description: Published v2022 sequential entry number within each party; NA for rows absent from v2022

columns.name: filtered
columns.description: Legacy khaiii morphological parse (Korean-only); empty for rows absent from v2022

columns.name: conservative
columns.description: Binary indicator: 1 = Conservative Party, 0 = Progressive Party

columns.name: id
columns.description: Global primary key. Published v2022 ids are preserved; new rows use their board_record_id

columns.name: board_record_id
columns.description: Stable official-board key '<namespace>_<source_id>'; empty when board provenance is unavailable

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: Published v2022 id for rows that belong to the v2022 release

columns.name: legacy_no
columns.description: Published v2022 no for rows that belong to the v2022 release

columns.name: id_scheme
columns.description: Scheme of the primary id: krpoltext_v2022 or board_source_v1

columns.name: crosswalk_method
columns.description: Audited rule that matched a v2022 row to an official board row

columns.name: party
columns.description: Party name as shown on the official site at collection time

columns.name: category
columns.description: Post category as shown on the official site

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Post number on the official board

columns.name: source_content_hash
columns.description: Hash recorded by the official-site collector before merging

columns.name: content_hash
columns.description: SHA-256 of normalized ymd, title, and text

columns.name: doc_type
columns.description: Document type derived from the board and category

columns.name: text_source
columns.description: Where 'text' came from: html, attachment, or image_only_html

columns.name: site_ymd
columns.description: Date as displayed on the official site

columns.name: date_is_placeholder
columns.description: Whether the site date is a migration placeholder ('true'/'false')

notes.missing_values: Collection and provenance columns are empty for v2022-only rows. 'no' and 'legacy_no' are NA for rows absent from v2022.
notes.party_names: Both parties have undergone frequent name changes. The 'partisan' column uses stable ideological labels rather than party names.
notes.text_processing: All text is UTF-8 encoded Korean. 'text' contains the full original text; 'filtered' contains the legacy khaiii parse for v2022 rows and is empty for the 38,070 new rows (see 'filtered_status').
notes.identifiers: 'id' is unique across all rows. The 83,201 v2022 rows keep their published 'id'; new rows use 'board_record_id' as 'id'. 2,444 v2022 rows were safely matched to an official post and carry both identifiers.
notes.provenance: The v2022 rows are preserved byte-for-byte; title, text, and filtered values are never replaced by re-collected content.
